mentions.name: Rust website monitoring service
mentions.description: A website monitoring service written in Rust. The checking engine was ported from the reqwest HTTP library to libcurl to properly capture DNS, connect, TLS, and first-byte timing breakdowns. The new engine was validated side by side with the original for weeks at 100k+ daily checks, reaching 99.8% agreement, with mismatches including Cloudflare challenges that returned 403 responses based on the HTTP/2 fingerprint regardless of user-agent.
mentions.problem: The previous reqwest-based checks could not properly capture DNS/connect/TLS/first-byte timing, and HTTP/2 fingerprint differences triggered Cloudflare 403 challenges during checks.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a website monitoring service written in Rust. I had to port from using the reqwest library to libcurl in order to properly capture DNS/connect/TLS/first-byte timing.
